# FilingLens

> FilingLens compares one SEC US-GAAP concept, entity, unit and exact period at two filing-date cutoffs. It returns both values and source accession links.

Free browser tools. Paid features are not available.

A difference is not a restatement diagnosis or investment signal. Missing or conflicting observations remain unresolved. Local MCP does not fetch data; browser SEC lookup is separate. Paid alerts are unavailable.
